_meta.purpose: Data-only rules consumed by gen-pi.py to port .claude/agents + .claude/commands/*.md into .pi/agents + .pi/prompts. Never edit generated output directly -- edit this file or the .claude/ sources, then re-run the generator.

frontmatter._note_keys: Pi keeps `name` (the subagent id used by subagent_run) and keeps `argument-hint` on prompt templates (Pi supports it natively, unlike OpenCode markdown commands). `$ARGUMENTS`/`$1` substitution works in Pi prompt templates as-is, so no rewrite is needed.

model_map._verified: Both ids listed as available by `pi --list-models` on this machine (provider claude-bridge, 1M context). The tiering of the Claude source is preserved 1:1 instead of collapsing both tiers onto one model.

thinking_map._note: Pi's `thinking` frontmatter field has no Claude Code equivalent; it is derived from the source model tier. Values are Pi thinking levels (off|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max).

tools_map._note: Keyed by the exact literal value of the source agent's `tools:` frontmatter field. `__no_tools_field__` is the sentinel for agents with no `tools:` key at all (full Claude default access); it maps to null, meaning the generated Pi agent also omits `tools` and therefore keeps the harness default set -- never narrowed beyond the Claude original.

Catches the remaining literal backtick-quoted tool-name mentions after propuesta-framing-claude-to-pi consumed the framing one. Order in this array matters -- rules apply sequentially. The plain 'Task -> <agente>' flow arrows in the pipeline diagram stay unchanged: they are human-readable plan notation, not executable calls, and match no drift pattern.
Same tool-neutral rewording the OpenCode port applies; 'Task' is not a Pi tool name.
Prose mentions of the read-only tool triple must name Pi's actual tools; Pi has no `Glob` tool (its equivalent is `find`).

_drift_patterns_note: Same baseline set as the OpenCode port: any of these surviving into generated output means a source edit introduced a Claude-specific mention with no matching rule.
open_items: Pi's default tool set for an agent with no `tools:` frontmatter key is assumed (not verified here) to include MCP access, which bibliografo-propuesta needs for openalex/semanticscholar/crossref. If a ported agent reports no MCP tools, add an explicit `tools` value for it in tools_map instead of narrowing the others.

`.mcp.json` mentions inside agent prose are left untouched: Pi reads project MCP servers from its own configuration, and rewriting the filename is out of scope for this generator (same boundary the OpenCode port draws).
